title: 전직대통령 예우에 관한 법률 / queue:ADDENDUM:02086:19690122:00001:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDUM <Act No. 2086, January 22, 1969>

This Act shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation and shall apply to former Presidents and their surviving family members since the establishment of the Government of the Republic of Korea.
